entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: So much of the technology here looks[n]futuristic, but Dr. Maruki's videos are[n]all on an outdated format...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Could it be a sign that he thinks of[n]the past as obsolete?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: At any rate, there's still a lot more we[n]need to figure out—and now that the[n]door's open, we ought to get on that.
